description: 2nd connection. 1st connection failed on two self-inflicted mistakes: (1) forgot this harness's fixed file->sh->cl->collect execution order (independent of JSON array order) - the cl-type TRADBUILD step actually ran AFTER all the sh-type steps, so CLEANUP deleted ZAISRV before TRADBUILD had created it, and BUILD1/BUILD2 ran against a library that didn't have ZAISRV yet at all; (2) wrote Rules.mk via a qsh heredoc, which this harness has repeatedly confirmed re-encodes to EBCDIC - makei's own Python code then failed with UnicodeDecodeError trying to read it, before any build logic ran. TRADBUILD itself (plain CRTRPGMOD/CRTSRVPGM from &LIB's QRPGLESRC/QSRVSRC members into &LIB2) succeeded and is still sitting in &LIB2 (confirmed via the 1st connection's own final collect), so this connection reuses that pre-existing, non-makei-built object directly - no need to redo TRADBUILD. All steps are sh-type only (no cl-type), avoiding the ordering trap entirely. Rules.mk is now written via python3 binary-mode (matching iproj.json's own already-safe recipe) instead of heredoc.

steps.label: SETUP
steps.cmd:
rm -rf "$HOME/mk9"
mkdir -p "$HOME/mk9/z"
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QRPGLESRC.FILE/ZAISRV.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk9/z/zaisrv.rpgle') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QSRVSRC.FILE/ZAISRV.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk9/z/zaisrv.bnd') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/python3 -c "open('$HOME/mk9/z/Rules.mk','wb').write(b'ZAISRV.MODULE: zaisrv.rpgle\nZAISRV.SRVPGM: ZAISRV.MODULE zaisrv.bnd\n')"
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/python3 -c "open('$HOME/mk9/z/iproj.json','wb').write(b'{\"version\":\"0.0.1\",\"objlib\":\"&LIB2\",\"curlib\":\"&LIB2\"}')"
echo ---RULES-MK---
cat "$HOME/mk9/z/Rules.mk" </dev/null
echo ---IPROJ-JSON---
cat "$HOME/mk9/z/iproj.json" </dev/null
echo

steps.label: EDITSRC
steps.cmd:
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/python3 -c "p='$HOME/mk9/z/zaisrv.rpgle'; d=open(p,'rb').read(); open(p,'wb').write(d + b'\n// verify-probe touch: force a source change\n')"
tail -c 80 "$HOME/mk9/z/zaisrv.rpgle" </dev/null
echo

steps.sql: SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJLIB FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB2', 'ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME = 'ZAISRV' ORDER BY OBJTYPE
